description: Run any kernelCAD tool by name. Use it when a tool description or a tool result tells you to call a tool that is not in your tool list (for example repair_script, execute_cookbook, trace_from_image or run_fea), and for tools found with search_tools. Pass the tool name and its arguments object as that tool's inputSchema describes; search_tools returns the schema. The result is the tool's own result.

name.description: Tool name, as returned by search_tools.

name: call_tool
title: Run Tool
